verdict.rationale: The evidence documents Microsoft Graph endpoints only for OneDrive files: driveItems, sharing links, search, delta, uploads and versions. Nothing in the pack shows member provisioning, group management, or admin endpoints for managing the team. The Graph-wide $metadata note mentions the broader Graph surface but gives no specific evidence of user or group admin APIs, so at most it counts as adjacent platform material.

support.subject: As an IT admin, the team is manageable by API — member provisioning, group management, and admin endpoints documented for automation
